doc.title: UX Design Specification - Visual Foundation
doc.snippet: Professional Blue color theme with complete palette: Primary #2563eb (Blue), Secondary #64748b (Slate), Success #10b981 (Green - value-added), Warning #f59e0b (Amber - non-value-added), Error #ef4444 (Red - waste). Typography system uses system font stack. Spacing scale based on 4px base unit. WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance required.

doc.title: UX Design Specification - Design System Foundation
doc.snippet: Material UI (MUI) as primary component library for all standard UI components. Used for: Buttons, forms, inputs, navigation, dialogs, layout, typography, icons. Custom components styled to match MUI theme. Proven libraries for specialized features (Video.js, Recharts).

doc.title: UX Design Specification - Component Library
doc.snippet: From Material UI: Buttons (primary, secondary, outlined, text, destructive), Text fields, Select, Cards, Lists, Dialogs, AppBar, Icons (Material Icons), Typography, Grid/Layout, Tooltips, Chips/Badges. Custom components: Video Timeline, Work Element List, Stacked Bar Chart, Yamazumi Chart, Upload Area.

doc.title: UX Design Specification - UX Pattern Decisions
doc.snippet: Button Hierarchy: Primary (blue #2563eb, white text), Secondary (outlined, blue border), Tertiary (text button), Destructive (red #ef4444). Form Patterns: Label above input, required field indicator (*), validation on blur, error display inline below input. Touch targets minimum 44px × 44px for mobile.

doc.title: Architecture - ADR-002: Material UI + Tailwind CSS Hybrid
doc.snippet: Use Material UI as primary component library, Tailwind for utility classes. Matches UX spec, enterprise-ready components, utility classes for custom styling. Two styling systems with clear separation (manageable approach).

doc.title: Architecture - Implementation Patterns
doc.snippet: Naming: Components PascalCase.tsx, utilities camelCase.ts, hooks usePrefix.ts. Code Organization: Components by feature. Error Handling: React Error Boundary + Material UI Snackbar. Color Coding: Waste Red (#ef4444), Non-value-added Yellow (#f59e0b), Value-added Green (#10b981).

doc.title: Epic 1: Foundation & Infrastructure - Story 1.4
doc.section: Story 1.4: Basic UI Framework & Design System
doc.snippet: Set up Tailwind CSS or similar utility-first CSS framework. Define design tokens (colors, typography, spacing). Create basic component library (Button, Input, Card, etc.). Implement color system: red (waste), yellow (non-value-added), green (value-added). Ensure high contrast for factory floor viewing. Create layout components (Header, Sidebar, Main content area).

doc.title: PRD - User Experience Principles
doc.snippet: Professional but approachable. Data-forward: Charts and visualizations are the hero. Color-coded throughout: Consistent red/yellow/green across all views. Clean and focused: Minimal chrome, maximum content visibility. High contrast for factory floor viewing (may be viewed on tablets in bright environments).

story-context.constraints: - Material UI must be the primary component library (enterprise-ready, matches UX spec) - Tailwind CSS can be used for utility classes alongside MUI (already configured) - Two styling systems must have clear separation (MUI for components, Tailwind for utilities) - Color system must use exact hex codes from UX spec: Red #ef4444 (waste), Yellow #f59e0b (non-value-added), Green #10b981 (value-added) - Waste categorization colors must be consistent across all themes and components - Typography must use system font stack (San Francisco, Segoe UI, Roboto) - Spacing scale must use 4px base unit (4px, 8px, 12px, 16px, 24px, 32px, 48px, 64px) - All components must follow WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards - Color contrast ratios must meet 4.5:1 minimum for text - Touch targets must be minimum 44px × 44px for mobile/tablet - Focus indicators must be visible (2px outline, #2563eb color) - Components must be responsive (Desktop ≥1024px, Tablet 768-1023px, Mobile <768px) - High contrast required for factory floor viewing (bright environments, tablets) - Naming conventions: Components PascalCase.tsx, utilities camelCase.ts - Code organization: Components by feature in folders (components/ui/, components/layout/) - Theme configuration must be in lib/theme.ts - TypeScript theme types must be in types/theme.ts - App metadata must be updated: title "Yamazumi", description "Video-based work element analysis tool for manufacturing" - Design system documentation must be created in docs/design-system.md - Follow Prettier formatting: single quotes, 2-space indent, semicolons, 100 char max width

tests.standards:
This project uses Playwright for E2E testing (already configured). Unit tests with Vitest will be configured in future stories. For this story, focus on E2E tests for UI component rendering and accessibility. Test patterns from existing tests in tests/e2e/ show:
- Use @playwright/test framework - Test files named *.spec.ts - Priority tags: @P0 (critical), @P1 (high priority) - Accessibility testing with Playwright's accessibility features - Responsive testing at different viewport sizes - Component rendering verification - Theme application verification
tests.locations: - tests/e2e/ - E2E tests using Playwright (already exists with example tests) - Future: tests/unit/ - Unit tests using Vitest (to be configured in later stories)

ideas.test: - Test MUI components render correctly after installation - Verify ThemeProvider is applied globally - Test Button variants render with correct styles (primary, secondary, tertiary, destructive) - Test Input component renders with label, help text, error states - Test Card component renders with correct variants (default, outlined, elevated)

- Verify theme colors match exact hex codes from UX spec - Test waste categorization colors are accessible (Red #ef4444, Yellow #f59e0b, Green #10b981) - Verify color contrast ratios meet WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 minimum) - Test colors display correctly in light and dark modes (if applicable)

- Verify system font stack is applied globally - Test typography scale renders correctly (H1-H4, body, small, tiny) - Verify font weights are correct (400, 500, 600, 700) - Test line heights (1.5 for body, 1.2 for headings)

- Test Header component responsive behavior (hamburger menu for mobile) - Test Sidebar component collapses on mobile (drawer behavior) - Test MainContent responsive grid at different breakpoints - Verify layout works at Desktop (≥1024px), Tablet (768-1023px), Mobile (<768px)

- Run Playwright accessibility audit on all components - Test keyboard navigation (Tab, Enter, Space through all interactive elements) - Verify focus indicators are visible (2px outline, #2563eb color) - Test screen reader support (ARIA labels present and correct) - Verify touch targets are minimum 44px × 44px for mobile - Test color contrast ratios with automated tools
- Verify app metadata updated: title "Yamazumi" - Verify description: "Video-based work element analysis tool for manufacturing" - Test theme is applied globally across all pages
